answer: The dawn cap is upheld at intake and terrace shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, as each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a marble tag. The deposit is 57 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
